programme.title: Greenland O Último Refúgio
programme.desc: Uma família luta pela sobrevivência quando um cometa destruidor de planetas chega à Terra. John Garrity, a sua ex-mulher e o seu filho fazem uma perigosa viagem até à sua derradeira esperança de salvação, à medida que a contagem decrescente para o apocalipse global se aproxima do zero.

programme.title: O Torneio
programme.desc: Numa cidade no norte de Inglaterra, um torneio é assistido por dezenas de homens ricos, com 30 concorrentes que estão dispostos a tudo para ganhar um prémio de 10 milhões de dólares. O objetivo é simples matar todos os adversários e ser o último sobrevivente de todos.

programme.title: Força Maior
programme.desc: Uma família sueca goza umas férias num resort dos Alpes Franceses, mas uma avalanche vai provocar o caos durante o almoço num restaurante na montanha, e as reações instintivas do casal vão causar uma fissura que pode provocar o fim da relação.

programme.title: Vem Ao Papá
programme.desc: Após receber uma carta enigmática do seu pai, que não vê desde os cinco anos, Norval viaja para ir ter com ele, na esperança de que esta seja uma oportunidade para se reaproximarem. Mas será que se ele soubesse a verdade sombria sobre o seu progenitor, ele o teria reencontrado

programme.title: Elyse
programme.desc: Memória e alucinação entrelaçam-se na vida de Elyse, institucionalizada num hospital psiquiátrico, sob os cuidados do Dr. Lewis e com as consequências de um trauma profundo.

programme.title: Xixi, Cama
programme.desc: Antoine é um solteirão, folião e sedutor, que tem de encontrar um novo companheiro com quem dividir as despesas do seu incrível apartamento em Paris. Aceita a proposta de Jeanne, 1m70, olhos azuis, mas só depois é que percebe que ela vem com duas crianças, que lhe vão fazer a vida negra.

programme.title: Milagre De Lourdes
programme.desc: O drama religioso, dedicado às aparições de Nossa Senhora na vida de Santa Bernadette, foi filmado em Portugal e conta com um grande elenco português. O filme apresenta uma Bernadette com 14 anos a lutar para ser ouvida e que sofreu pela sua determinação.

programme.title: Os Pobres Anos Dourados
programme.desc: Um casal reformado recusa-se a aceitar o corte das suas reformas e reúne um grupo de amigos para lutar pelos direitos de todos. A estratégia é simples assaltar bancos.

programme.title: As Coisas Que Dizemos, As Coisas Que Fazemos
programme.desc: Daphne, grávida de três meses, está de férias no campo e enquanto espera que o seu companheiro François, ausente em trabalho, vá ter com ela, vai-se aproximando de Maxime, um primo que nunca conhecera e de quem vai ficando cada vez mais íntima.

programme.title: Bullitt
programme.desc: O tenente Frank Bullitt é um polícia de San Francisco com pouca paciência para as regras, que fará tudo para apanhar o barão do crime que mandou matar a testemunha que estava sob sua proteção.

programme.title: Mojin E O Templo Perdido
programme.desc: No início da década de 90, o famoso explorador de túmulos Hu Bayi decidiu reformar-se com a sua noiva, Shirley, mas são convencidos a regressar às lides por uma mulher misteriosa, que quer descobrir o túmulo de uma princesa mongol para possuir um artefacto que tem o poder de ressuscitar os mortos.

programme.title: Magia E Sedução
programme.desc: Sally e Gillian Owens são duas irmãs descendentes de uma família de bruxas que carrega uma maldição centenária. Agora elas terão de enfrentar vários feitiços inesperados e ultrapassar todos os obstáculos para encontrar o verdadeiro amor.

programme.title: Decisão De Partir
programme.desc: Um homem morre após cair de uma montanha na Coreia do Sul. O detetive Hae-joon investiga o caso e suspeita da enigmática viúva, Seo-rae, mas acaba por se apaixonar por ela, ficando dividido entre o dever profissional e uma perigosa paixão.

programme.title: O Último A Cair
programme.desc: Após uma pandemia ter dizimado o mundo, o antigo soldado John Wood vive isolado numa floresta até lhe aparecer a pedir ajuda uma mulher ferida que parece ter o segredo para acabar com o vírus.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 2 Hades
programme.desc: Anos após a espetacular fuga de Ray Breslin da prisão, um dos elementos da sua nova força de segurança de elite desaparece no interior de uma cadeia ilegal chamada Hades, onde os prisioneiros são forçados a lutar entre si. A única forma de o libertar vai ser entrar lá para dentro também.

programme.title: É Só Querer
programme.desc: Após uma vida de estudo, um professor universitário, um explicador e um desempregado continuam sem dinheiro. A solução para os seus problemas pode estar num comprimido, que um deles criou, e que é uma droga que dá uma grande energia mas sem ressaca

programme.title: O Segredo Do Refúgio
programme.desc: Dois casais alugam um refúgio perfeito à beira-mar, mas em pouco tempo o que deveria ser um fim de semana de descanso assume contornos sinistros

programme.title: O Doutrinador
programme.desc: Às vésperas das eleições presidenciais no Brasil, uma tragédia pessoal leva um agente treinado a lançar-se numa cruzada contra a corrupção endémica do país e os políticos e empresários que enriquecem às custas da miséria e do trabalho da população.

programme.title: Tração
programme.desc: Um grupo de amigos praticantes de motocross é convidado para uma competição única, o MotoAthlon, realizado pelo egocêntrico político DiMello, após a qual acaba por cair numa armadilha.

programme.title: A Rainha De Espanha
programme.desc: Durante a década de 1950, a estrela de Hollywood Macarena Granada regressa à sua Espanha natal para participar numa super-produção cinematográfica. Só que quando um antigo colega é preso e colocado em trabalhos forçados, toda a equipa de rodagem decide montar um plano para libertá-lo.

programme.title: Ice Merchants
programme.desc: Um homem e o seu filho saltam de paraquedas todos os dias, da sua casa fria e vertiginosa presa no alto de um precipício, para se deslocarem à aldeia que se situa na planície abaixo, onde vendem o gelo que produzem durante a noite.

programme.title: Berlin, I Love You
programme.desc: O mais recente filme da série Cidades do Amor, desta vez dedicado à capital alemã, Berlim. Uma dezena de histórias diferentes que se cruzam em Berlim, desde uma filha que encontra o pai que não vê desde a infância a uma noite de afirmação feminina e de celebração numa pequena lavandaria.

programme.title: A Lenda De Bagger Vance
programme.desc: Rannulph Januh é um herói da Primeira Guerra Mundial que aceita participar num campeonato de golfe com dois grandes profissionais da época, Walter Hagen e Bobby Jones. Durante o torneio ele conhece Bagger Vance, um caddy que o ajuda durante o torneio e possui o segredo do balanço perfeito.

programme.title: 57 Segundos
programme.desc: Franklin Fausti é um blogger que consegue uma entrevista com Anton Burrell, um guru da tecnologia, e que acaba por lhe salvar a vida no lançamento do seu mais recente produto. Nesse processo, encontra um anel misterioso que permite a quem o usa recuar 57 segundos para o passado.

programme.title: Golpe Final
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de terroristas lhe raptam a sobrinha no estádio do West Ham durante um jogo de futebol, Michael Knox, um ex-soldado, trava uma guerra sem quartel para a salvar e prevenir uma bomba de explodir no recinto, que tem 35 mil pessoas lá dentro impedidas de sair.

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Após sobreviver à morte, a assassina contratada Elektra, perita em martes marciais, acaba por ver-se a proteger os seus dois alvos, um pai solteiro e a sua única filha, de um grupo de criminosos sobrenaturais.

programme.title: Fora De Controlo
programme.desc: Thomas Craven é um veterano da polícia que investiga o homicídio da própria filha, na sequência do qual descobre uma conspiração empresarial e governamental de proporções inesperadas.

programme.title: O Último Viking
programme.desc: Um jovem viking chamado Vitharr chega à Britânia com sonhos de conquistas e aventuras, mas quando a sua família e o seu clã são emboscados e mortos, ele tem de sobreviver sozinho nesta terra estranha e perigosa.

programme.title: Plano De Fuga 3
programme.desc: Quando a filha de um magnata da tecnologia de Hong Kong é atirada para uma prisão de segurança máxima na Letónia, o especialista em segurança Ray Breslin é contratado para resgatá-la. Só que a namorada dele também é raptada e a missão já de si difícil passa a ser de vida ou de morte.

programme.title: Ratazana Assassina
programme.desc: Brody é um ranger que se prepara para abrir um novo parque de campismo, com a ajuda dos sobrinhos. Tudo parece estar em ordem até que uma ratazana gigante, que sofreu uma mutação devido aos resíduos tóxicos, começar a matar tudo o que lhe aparece à frente.

programme.title: J. S. Bach – Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: Maestro Jaap van Zweden conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 in D minor, Op. 47. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, on March 9, 2016.

programme.title: Berg - Piano Sonata, Op. 1
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Molteni (1998) performs Alban Berg’s Piano Sonata in B minor, Op. 1. Molteni began studying the piano at the age of six. He graduated with honors and honorable mention at the Conservatorio di musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como, and was awarded a master’s degree Magna cum Laude in Advanced Performance Studies by the Conservatorio della Svizzera Italiana in Lugano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schubert, Hahn, Ullmann a. o.
programme.desc: Bass-baritone Matthias Hoffmann (Austria, 1991) and pianist Lisa Ochsendorf (Germany, 1991) perform ‘Il modo di prender morale’ from Franz Schubert’s Drei Lieder, Op. 83, D. 902; ‘Le faune’ from Claude Debussy’s Fêtes galantes II, L. 114; ‘Du alte Ananasbirne’ from Miroslav Srnka’s Dreizehn Lieder; Alphons Diepenbrock’s Simeons lofzang, RC 120; Carl Loewe’s Odins Meeresritt, Op.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 2
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Schubert - Winterreise
programme.desc: Baritone Samuel Hasselhorn and pianist Daniel Heide perform Franz Schubert’s song cycle Winterreise (‘Winter’s journey’). The 30-year-old Schubert wrote this masterpiece in 1827, just a year before his death. Like Schubert’s earlier song cycle Die schöne Müllerin (1823), Winterreise is a setting of the poetry of Wilhelm Müller (1794-1827).

programme.title: Brahms - Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in a wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, violinist Tedi Papavrami, violist Lyda Chen-Argerich, cellist Mischa Maisky, and pianist Lily Maisky perform Johannes Brahms’s Piano Quartet No. 3 in C minor, Op. 60.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 16, Op. 135
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication.

programme.title: Baroque works by Bach, Muffat and Rameau
programme.desc: Paul Goodwin conducts the Conjunto Barroco of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid in a Baroque music program featuring works by Georg Muffat, J. S. Bach, and Jean-Philippe Rameau. On the program are Muffat’s Sonata No. 5 in G major, 'Armonico tributo'; Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; and Rameau’s Suite from the opera ‘Les Boréades’.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience.

programme.title: The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra, also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. The ensemble is directed by violinist Jeanne Lamon. In ‘The Galileo Project: Music of the Spheres’ they perform music by Monteverdi, Vivaldi, Bach and Handel to a backdrop of high-definition images from the Hubble telescope, NASA and Canadian astronomers.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw (2020)
programme.desc: Misha Fomin performed romantic piano works at the Amsterdam Concertgebouw in November 2020. His recital opened with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Sonata No. 10, Op. 14/2 and Sonata No. 15, Op. 28 'Pastoral'. He continued the program with a performance of Frédéric Chopin's Nocturne Op. 9/1, Etude Op. 25/7, and Johannes Brahms's technically demanding 'Variations on a Theme by Paganini', Op. 35 (Book II).

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2, 'Resurrection'
programme.desc: Maestro Myung-Whun Chung leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino, along with two vocal soloists, in this impressive performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 2 in C minor, ‘Resurrection’. Soprano Christiane Karg and alto Claudia Huckle are the soloists. Written between 1888 and 1894, this five-movement symphony is scored for a large orchestra, chorus, and soprano and alto soloists.

programme.title: Homage to Yehudi Menuhin
programme.desc: On 22 April 2016, Yehudi Menuhin would have celebrated his 100th birthday. One of his most famous students - and one of his best friends - is violinist Daniel Hope. For him, Yehudi Menuhin was the reason he become a violinist. At first, his mother became the secretary of Menuhin when Daniel Hoe and his parents moved to London.

programme.title: Liszt - Elegies No. 1 and 2 (S. 130 And 131)
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Franz Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Richard Strauss - A Hero's Life, Op. 40
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a concert performing Richard Strauss' Ein Heldenleben, Op. 40. Violin soloist is David Radzynski. Recorded at Severance Hall in Cleveland in February 2023. Strauss, at the age of 34, sparked outrage when he cast himself as the central figure of his tone poem. Generally agreed to be autobiographical, the work contains more than thirty quotations from Strauss's earlier works.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Swan Lake (2015)
programme.desc: The Imperial Ice Stars are an ensemble of 24 world class skaters, holding more than 300 competition medals between them. Praised by critics and audiences alike, they never fail to enchant with creative and powerful story-telling, sumptuous sets, spectacular special effects and opulent costumes.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 2, Op. 17
programme.desc: American conductor Michael Tilson Thomas leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in an energetic performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's folk-infused Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17. Written in 1872, the work is nicknamed 'Little Russian' as the composer used several folk tunes from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia’. This performance was recorded at LSO St Luke's, London, on May 31, 2021.

programme.title: Sinding - Serenade in A major, Op. 92
programme.desc: Violinists Francesca Dego and Domenico Nordio and pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Serenade in A major, Op. 92 by Norwegian composer Christian Sinding (1856-1941). Together with Edvard Grieg, Sinding was Norway’s best-known composer at the turn of the century. Composing in the late Romantic style, Sinding’s oeuvre includes a large number of piano pieces, chamber music, and songs.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Iolanta
programme.desc: ‘Iolanta’ and ‘Perséphone’ – A double bill consisting of two stage works that “represent an ideal of beauty, poetry and hope” forms this new production by Peter Sellars in Madrid from the Teatro Real from 2012. In both works, the progression from darkness to light acts as an initiation rite that completely transforms the existential attitude of the leading characters.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto And Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in this concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, on April 21, 2016. The program opens with Felix Mendelssohn’s concert overture Die Hebriden, Op. 26 (The Hebrides). During a trip to Scotland, the composer was deeply impressed by the natural splendor of Staffa, an island of the Inner Hebrides, which inspired him to compose his concert overture.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Dvorák - Symphony No. 7, Op. 70
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Antonín Dvorák's Symphony No. 7 in D minor, Op. 70. The work was completed in March 1885 and premiered one month later in London conducted by the composer himself. With its dramatic and dark style, this symphony stands in stark contrast to the predominantly optimistic tone of Dvorák’s broader oeuvre.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - II: Le Sacrifice
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes.

programme.title: Arvo Pärt - Kanon Pokajanen
programme.desc: Arvo Pärt based his ‘Kanon Pokajanen’ (from ‘Canon of Repentance to Our Lord Jesus Christ’, 1995-97) on the canon of repentance as handed down in the earliest Slavic-Christian manuscripts, dating back to the sixth century after Christ. The canon symbolizes the change, the transformation from day to night, the Old and New Testament, prophecy and the fulfillment, the here and now and the hereafter.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 2 BWV 1015
programme.desc: Johann Sebastian Bach probably wrote this set of six Sonatas for Violin and Harpsichord during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig. Maybe this is why these pieces are well playable for amateurs, while every sonata still has the finesse that can offer a challenge to professional musicians.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Nine Symphonies That Changed the World
programme.desc: Founded by Daniel Barenboim and Edward Said, the West-Eastern Divan Orchestra is composed of young musicians from Israel, Palestine, several other Arab countries, and Spain. The musicians band together at least once a year to rehearse and perform on stage, where their shared love of music crosses national, ethnic, and religious boundaries.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 5, Op. 18, No. 5
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. This symphony shows Beethoven’s loyalty to the model of Joseph Haydn’s and Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s late symphonies, yet reveals his attempt to distinguish himself from his predecessors.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam, recorded in De Doelen, Rotterdam, in 2018. Alvaro Siviero is the soloist in Grieg's Piano Concerto No. 1, and closes his performance with 'Dansa do Índio Branco' by Villa-Lobos. Grieg's Piano Concerto, Op. 16, composed in 1868, was the only concerto the composer completed. It is one of his most popular works and is among the most popular of all piano concertos.

programme.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge in a concert program dedicated to American composer George Gershwin. The program opens with Gershwin’s symphonic suite Catfish Row (arr. Steven D. Bowen) which is based upon music from his famous opera Porgy and Bess (1935). This is followed by the well-known tone poem An American in Paris (1928).

programme.title: Ravel - Ma mère l'Oye
programme.desc: At the behest of Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich, several classical music stars took part in this concert in aid of the Erasmus Fund for medical research in intensive care, recorded at the Royal Conservatory of Brussels, Belgium, on October 21, 2023. The concert pays tribute to the renowned cellist Aleksandr Khramouchin (1979) who suddenly passed away on May 13, 2023.

programme.title: Liszt Mosaics- II
programme.desc: This dance concert - performed in the languages of both music and movement - features, in addition to works by Liszt, some of the finest pieces of Hungary's national romanticism that served to inspire them, antecedents of sacred music reaching as far back as the Gregorian period and compositions by contemporaries who influenced Liszt: Paganini and Chopin. Liszt Mosaics is founded on three thematic pillars.

programme.title: Kristine Opolais Recital
programme.desc: Critics praise her, and the audience loves her. Kristine Opolais, the prima donna and the star of the New York Metropolitan Opera, performs in her home country Latvia. She gives a splendid concert with the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra, at the Latvian National Opera, in 2017. The program includes arias from operas that made Kristine an international star.

programme.title: Schumann - Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: German conductor Christian Zacharias leads the Orchestre national de Lille in a concert program dedicated to Robert Schumann. The concert opens with the ‘Genoveva’ Overture, Op. 81. Although Schumann’s only opera Genoveva is not often performed, its overture established itself as an autonomous work in concert halls.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 21 - III
programme.desc: Julijana Sarac performs the first/third movement of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 21 (“Waldstein”). The work was completed in 1804 and is considered one of Beethoven's greatest and most technically challenging piano sonatas.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - I. L'Adoration de la Terre
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes.

programme.title: Brahms - Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2013 - Prague
programme.desc: Every year since 1991, the Berliner Philharmoniker has given concerts in a different European city on each May 1st. These concerts have become known as ‘Europakonzert’. Every guest city has its own special cultural importance. These concerts have served two purposes: to commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra’s founding on May 1st, 1882, and to celebrate the common heritage of the Old World.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
programme.desc: Stefano Demicheli conducts the Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici and soloists Nicola Cianncio (bass) and Catherine Jones (cello) in a varied baroque music program, recorded at Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Seina in Naples, Italy.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig’s St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz’s collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach.

programme.desc: No ‘Língua Mãe’, Carlos Alberto Moniz sai em busca dos autores portugueses. Gente que escreve, compõe, pinta, encena, sempre no seu próprio mundo solitário, por vezes desconhecido de quem não vê TV, rádio, internet, exposições, passagens de modelos ou de quem não tem hábitos de leitura. programme.desc: Na Nazaré, a feira mistura-se com o vento, sal e com o som do mar. É uma extensão da vida piscatória, mas também uma celebração da terra e da fé. Aqui a feira não é só comércio — é mar e monte, fé e sustento, é história a acontecer à sombra dos toldos e ao som do pregão. Aqui, tudo tem cor: os sapatos as vozes, as saias das mulheres que vendem com orgulho e graça. As vozes são firmes, as saias são sete.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: O restaurador de mobília Steve Norman resgata uma secretária de campanha militar. Ted Edley transforma um carro a pedais os anos 60 num de corrida.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T6 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Ted Edley e Gilder Ruth Tappin transformam um lustre de lírios francês. Robin Johnson trabalha num guarda-roupa de um imóvel irlandês que está a cair.

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T5 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Wes apanha outra presa, mas quando um grande grupo entra no seu acampamento, as tensões exaltam-se. Bulent migra para o buraco de água de Seth. Será que os dois vão unir forças?

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T5 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Wes e a equipa recebem a sua terceira presa da grande prova, mas a vitória rapidamente se torna uma perigosa situação médica. Bulent é posto à prova por uma onda de calor.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: O trabalho continua com as surpresas habituais. Conseguir o capot certo é complicado, mas o trabalho da carroçaria neste camião é onde a arte da construção realmente sobressai.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: O C10 entra na montagem final, mas a equipa esforça-se para que a carroçaria encaixe na perfeição. Além disso, os estofos sofrem problemas uns atrás dos outros.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T11 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Conheceremos os designers e os artesãos por detrás de luvas de basebol, chapéus de cowboys e elétrodos médicos para descobrir as fascinantes histórias de como são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Pára choques, bengalas doces, gel reluzente e modelos a vapor estão entre os objetos do quotidiano que vão ser vistos ao microscópio.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Saiba como são feitos os objetos do dia a dia tais como chapéus de chuva, faqueiros de prata, fitas métricas e motores de barcos.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O XJX é a versão de duas portas do XJ6 de quatro. O último Jaguar a ser criado pelo Sir William Lyons, este icónico carro irá atrair admiradores.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Mike consegue deitar as mãos aos Audi TT Quattro mais barato que encontra - a 450 km a sul dali. Conseguirá Edd arranjar a caixa de velocidades e ter lucro?

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Em Queensland, Rod reúne mais de 200 vacas prenhes para ganhar dinheiro. Uma bomba financeira vinda de casa obriga JC a duplicar o seu objetivo de ganhos para a viagem.

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A apenas uma semana antes de JC regressar a casa para o nascimento do 1.º filho, Rod fez vários planos para ganhar dinheiro. Conseguirão atingir o seu novo objetivo de 20 000 §?

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Siga os Kilchers e a sua comunidade isolada nos subúrbios de Homer, no Alasca. A família tem cultivado e vivido na sua propriedade há quatro gerações.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os Kilchers enfrentam o inverno mais quente das últimas décadas. Atz Lee e Eivin enfrentam uma missão de urgência para assegurar as suas casas na baía.

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T8 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Os mineiros de ouro do Yukon estão de volta e arriscam tudo na esperança de fazer fortuna. Na corrida ao ouro, quem irá sair vitorioso como o rei de Klondike?

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T8 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Os mineiros de ouro do Yukon estão de volta e arriscam tudo na esperança de fazer fortuna. Na corrida ao ouro, quem irá sair vitorioso como o rei de Klondike?

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T8 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Os mineiros de ouro do Yukon estão de volta e arriscam tudo na esperança de fazer fortuna. Na corrida ao ouro, quem irá sair vitorioso como o rei de Klondike?

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T8 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: O Klondike é assolado por um gigantesco incêndio florestal que ameaça o terreno de Parker. Tony precisa da sua barcaça para funcionar, mas conseguirá Sheamus entregá-la?

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Bisturis, tintas a óleo, capacetes da polícia britânica e machados de gelo são alguns dos objetos do quotidiano sob escrutínio neste episódio.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Alguma vez se perguntou como objetos como bacon, sopradores de neve e carros de luxo são feitos? Saiba como são feitos estes objetos tão familiares.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T19 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: À medida que mais objetos são analisados, saiba como as transmissões de veículos, talheres em miniatura, cestos de balões de ar quente e dardos são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T4 - Ep. 45
programme.desc: Este programa leva-nos até aos fabricante para vermos como determinados produtos do dia-a-dia são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T20 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Descubra como são feitos os tambores de nativos curandeiros, as passas, os estereoscópicos e os microfones de fita.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T20 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Descubra como são feitos os freios de cavalos, os cereais de aveia, as joias de turquesa e as scooters elétricas.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T20 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Descubra como são feitos os alicates das unhas, os tacos de jade, a sidra de gelo e os esquis aquáticos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T20 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Descubra como são feitos os coches, os marcadores da via rodoviária, a olaria e os depósitos das motas personalizados.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T20 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Saiba como são feitos as réplicas das gaitas de foles, os bebedouros, licor de laranja e os arcos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T12 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são vistos ao microscópio para sabermos como aparafusadoras pneumáticas, lavatórios de mármore e banana frita são feitos.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Drew desafia o restaurador de peles, Martin, a anexar um saco de críquete antigo num carro pré-guerra. O artista Nick e o madeireiro, Chris, trabalham num buda esculpido.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T3 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O estofador, Craig, deve ser extremamente cuidadoso ao trabalhar numa cadeira francesa rara. A especialista em iluminação, Jolene, é firme com uma lanterna de 200 anos.

programme.title: Mestres Do Restauro T3 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Drew desafia dois especialistas em autómatos para dar vida a um mágico de 130 anos. O trabalhador de metal, Ted, trabalha num par de luzes dos Teatros de West End.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T7 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma família pede à equipa para renovar uma propriedade abandonada. Criam uma nova casa de banho, um quarto e um espaço de ioga e no exterior acrescentam um jardim.

programme.title: Maine Cabin Masters T7 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Um homem compra um barraco de lagosta abandonado. Com um prazo apertado, a equipa trabalha rápido para criar um espaço de vida vibrante e construir novas docas de fácil acesso.

programme.title: Caçadores De Fantasmas T14 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: A equipa vai a Globe no Arizona. Investiga uma prisão e um tribunal cheios de violência e mistério. O que é que o local revelará?

programme.title: Expedição X T4 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Josh Gates envia a equipa para o local mais assombrado da América: a Ilha Mackinac, que tem assistido a mais de mil anos de derramamento de sangue.

programme.title: Expedição X T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Jess e Phil juntam-se aos The Ghost Brothers, enquanto investigam os mistérios da Ilha Mackinac. Exploram um farol com um passado negro.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Deep T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade investiga de que forma o conhecimento de antigas técnicas de construção de navios pode trazer alguma luz sobre a verdade do dilúvio de Noé.

programme.title: Mysteries Of The Deep T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Jeremy Wade investiga uma nova teoria que poderia explicar o que aconteceu ao mais mal-afamado braço de mar do mundo. Será que este mistério contínuo está prestes a ser resolvido?

programme.title: Aventura À Flor Da Pele XL T5 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Desesperadas por comer, Gwen e Sarah lideram a linha da frente para construir uma besta no mato, enquanto Ryan sente a pressão. E, uma discussão acesa leva Bulent a agir.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: A oficina faz-se à estrada com os seus modelos mais recentes para verificar a concorrência. Will e o primo de Dave, Brad, dão as suas opiniões sobre os carros com que se cruzam.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: O que começa por ser uma simples reparação do motor de um Roadster V8 de 1935 transforma-se numa reconstrução completa. A oficina é levada ao limite com este carro.

programme.title: Chapa E Pintura T9 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: O Nomad de 1955 é um carro icónico, mas a potência original não é suficiente para o atual proprietário, que quer que a equipa coloque uma ventoinha para aumentar a potência.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T12 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Mais objetos são vistos ao microscópio para sabermos como os cortadores hidráulicos Hurst Jaws of Life, árvores de Natal artificiais e bolachas de água e sal são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T20 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Saiba como são feitos os lenços de papel, as caravanas, as pantufas e os capacetes de mota.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T20 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Descubra como são feitos os cadeados em U, as tendas, os croissants e as malas de viagem.

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Mike quer gastar o dinheiro num autocarro personalizado, mas Edd prefere uma caravana mais conservadora. Edd é o perito, mas terá a sua estratégia dividendos?

programme.title: Joias Sobre Rodas T11 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Mike encontra-se à procura de um roadster de dois lugares com personalidade em forma de original BMW Z1. Este desportivo pode dar um bom lucro!

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T2 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Caçadores De Pedras Preciosas T2 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Na região vinícola de Margaret River, JC arranja à dupla um trabalho de poda numa adega. Em Shark Bay, a equipa negoceia com um produtor de pérolas.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T4 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Atz Lee e Shane têm de mover uma ponte de duas toneladas para assegurar o atravessamento de rios glaciares, enquanto Otto e Charlotte lutam contra uma ameaça ao seu gado.

programme.title: Alasca, A Última Fronteira T4 - Ep. 3

programme.title: A Febre Do Ouro T8 - Ep. 8

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T20 - Ep. 11

programme.desc: Mais objetos do dia-a-dia são analisados à lupa enquanto descobrimos como é que os leques, óleo de nozes e o cobre são feitos.

programme.title: O Segredo Das Coisas T21 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 76
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 114
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 58
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 77
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: The Art Farmer Quartet live In England
programme.desc: Art Farmer: Live in '64?highlights an amazing one-hour concert featuring the great flugelhornist in his prime. Farmer’s band includes legendary guitarist Jim Hall (fresh from Sonny Rollins’ band), drummer Pete LaRoca, and Steve Swallow on bass. The legendary ensemble plays both standards and originals with ease and finesse and highlights why Farmer was considered one of the most innovative horn players in all of jazz.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who was a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard And The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone.

programme.title: Spiral
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen/Robert Sadin, Puncha Puncha
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Chamber music: Sissoko And Segal
programme.desc: Hailing from a long tradition of Malian kora players, Ballake Sissoko has worked with renowned musicians such as Toumani Diabaté and Taj Mahal. He met the French born Vincent Ségal by chance, and the two began jamming together, uncertain of what kind of music might result.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Amaury Faye performed with his trio at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Funk in Deep Freeze
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Tribute to Monk
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Teddy Wilson - Théâtre de l’Atelier
programme.desc: Decades after the 1930s swing era came to an end, one of its giants, pianist Teddy Wilson (1912–1986), kept the flame of this music alive during countless international concert tours. During a hectic spring tour of Europe, the acclaimed pianist appeared at Geneva’s Théâtre de l’Atelier on March 21, 1969.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Stranger than Paranoia
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Conservatory Concert Big Band
programme.desc: As part of the International Duke Ellington Conference 2014, we welcome the Concert Big Band of the Conservatory of Amsterdam for a special concert. Under the direction of David Berger, they will play Duke Ellington’s only written big band symphony, ‘Black, Brown and Beige’. It has been more than 70 years since Ellington’s “B, B And B” was played in its entirety during its premiere at Carnegie Hall (New York).

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, Cuban pianist and vocalist Roberto Fonseca performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: F.B. Orch., B.E. Ba., T.J. and M.L. Ba. - Newport
programme.desc: In 1968 traden het orkest van de Belgische pianist Francy Boland, de band van de Nederlandse trompettist Boy Edgar en de Amerikaanse band van trompettist Thad Jones en drummer Mel Lewis op tijdens het Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam.

programme.title: Jackie Davis in concert in Brussels
programme.desc: American soul jazz singer and organist Jackie Davis (1920-1999) contributed greatly to the popularity of the Hammond B3 organ in jazz, preceding even the great Jimmy Smith. Seen here during an intimate solo performance in Brussels in 1967, we get to enjoy Davis’ every musical twist and lyrical turn.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Berlin
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Minor Swing
programme.desc: To celebrate the release of Django, the Parisian New Morning Club pays tribute to the legendary guitarist Django Reinhardt. The program showcases the magic of Reinhardt’s compositions, as well as the virtuosity of one of his most famous heirs: Stochelo Rosenberg. With unbridled passion and enthusiasm, Rosenberg interprets the music that marked French musical heritage: gypsy jazz.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part I
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: NSJ Vocal Selection: Carter, O'Day and Benjamin
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Christian Scott
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Mondriaan Jazz 2017: FORQ
programme.desc: Forq is an instrumental quartet with an aggressive sound and a penchant for sonic exploration. Originally founded by keyboardist?Henry Hey?(David Bowie, Empire of the Sun, and Jeff 'Tain' Watts) and bassist?Michael League?(Grammy-winning founder of Snarky Puppy), Forq is joined by guitarist?Chris McQueen?and drummer?Jason 'JT' Thomas.

programme.title: Ode to Miles: Bitches Brew Beyond
programme.desc: For the 40th anniversary of jazz legend Miles Davis' legendary album Bitches Brew, trumpeter Wallace Roney leads a band that revives the master's music. This project is the brainchild of Miles' family (including his son Erin), which is represented by his nephew, drummer Vince Wilburn. This concert at the ancient theater in Vienne, France, is a grand tribute to Miles.

programme.title: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Quartet - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1991, Cuban pianist Gonzalo Rubalcaba was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Wynton in the South Bank Show
programme.desc: Considered one of the most technically brilliant players in the history of the trumpet, jazz musician Wynton Marsalis is also a master of classical music and a fine composer. Marsalis takes the cameras with him around New York, to his home town of New Orleans, and to his rehearsal studios where he and his assembled band of musicians are seen putting together the album Blood on the Fields.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Oslo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Esplanada Music And Art in Concert
programme.desc: Esplanada was brought to life by Eddy Koopman, a long time Metropol Orkest member and composer. However, unlike other leading members in musical acts along the globe, Koopman does not put emphasis on himself. Most of the music he composes are for the Rotterdam Conservatory graduate violinist Sarah Koch.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: Duets II: The Great Performances
programme.desc: Duets II: The Great Performances is a visually stunning video companion to Tony Bennett's history-making #1 album, Duets II. The concert features the full song performances from Tony and today's greatest artists as they were recorded live in the studio. The musical segments are enhanced by insights on the process from Tony and the duet partners, providing an inside look at this landmark album in an unprecedented career.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Gerald Clayton
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Chucho's Mood
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: The vibrant island of Malta was in for a night of light and cheerful music when Brazilian music legend João Bosco took the stage on July 21, 2018. The self-taught guitarist made his music debut in the 1970s alongside Elis Regina and Aldir Blanc.

programme.title: Stingray PausePlay: Natalia M. King
programme.desc: We Pause and chat with local and international artists to get an in-depth look at their lives and music, they Play some amazing music in these, one-of-a-kind, live sessions! These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life.

programme.title: Al McKay's Earth, Wind And Fire Experience
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Free Jazz in Kongressaal Munich: Cecil Taylor
programme.desc: In the midst of the blossoming of the free-jazz scene, pianist Cecil Taylor (1929) probably represented the non-jazz aspect of the movement better than anyone else. Many of the innovations of the 1960s were pioneered by his records. His fusion of exuberance and atonality was particularly influential.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: Peter Beets Trio And Goudsmit: Tribute to Montgomery
programme.desc: World-class Dutch jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson, and John Clayton. His mother a music teacher and his father an Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey enthusiast, Beets was surrounded by music from an early age.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2019, French guitarist Paul Jarret performed with renowned New York drummer Jim Black at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: MPB Sessions - Pedro Viáfora And Celso Viáfora
programme.desc: Pedro Viáfora and Celso Viáfora are a father-and-son duo that brings together different generations of Brazilian music. Celso is a renowned composer with an extensive discography, while Pedro began his career with the group 5 a Seco before developing his solo work.

programme.title: Erroll Garner: Belgium 1963
programme.desc: Erroll Garner: Live in '63 And '64?presents two beautifully filmed concerts featuring his classic trio of bassist Eddie Calhoun and drummer Kelly Martin.

programme.title: Al di Meola - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1993, American guitarist Al Di Meola was one of the artists appearing here.

programme.title: Jacob Karlzon Trio - Open Waters
programme.desc: Swedish pianist Jacob Karlzon is joined by Danish bassist Morten Ramsbøl and Swedish drummer Rasmus Kihlberg at the Steinway piano factory in Hamburg to present their album ‘Open Waters’. Karlzon, a classically trained pianist who shared a stage with Kenny Wheeler, Norma Winstone, and Billy Cobham keeps the rich tradition of Swedish jazz eclecticism alive.

programme.title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 And '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 And '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans’ ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Bireli Lagrene
programme.desc: Biréli Lagrène is a French jazz guitarist born on September 4, 1966 in a family of gypsy tradition. His brother and his father introduced him from an early age to the repertoire of Django Reinhardt, whose influence is still felt in the style of Lagrène. In this performance, Lagrène pays homage to Django Reinhardt with his son, Babik Reinhardt.

programme.title: Buddy Rich and his Big Band at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: Buddy Rich: Live in '78 highlights the relentless power and unparalleled artistry of the man who was known as ‘The World’s Greatest Drummer.’ This concert, taped in Holland in 1978, showcases one of the tightest big bands in history, featuring acclaimed saxophonist Steve Marcus and other members of Buddy’s ‘Killer Force,’ the group he would later call ‘the best band I ever had.

programme.title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the 'young lions' of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions.

programme.title: Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Episode 6: Herbie Hancock - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American keyboard player and bandleader Herbie Hancock (1940) achieved success as an incisive, harmonically provocative jazz pianist in the 1960s, then went on to gain wide popularity as a leader of electric jazz-rock groups. One of these, Hancock’s band The Headhunters, ushered in a new era of jazz that appealed to a far wider audience, making jazz listeners out of rhythm and blues fans, and vice versa.

programme.title: James Brown - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1981, legendary American singer James Brown gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Greatest Classics T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Hector 'Macho' Camacho, always entertaining and flamboyant, stepping into the ring with 62-4 Tony Menefee in Lincoln, Nebraska. Camacho was on the comeback trail, following an up and down year that saw him defeat the legendary Sugar Ray Leonard by TKO before dropping a unanimous decision to Oscar De La Hoya for the WBC Welterweight Title. With his eyes on another title shot he faces Menefee, in the midst of a 14-fight win streak.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Andre Berto defending the WBC welterweight title against former WBA champion Luis Collazo. Each fighter had their own share of getting stunned throughout the bout, and the judges' decision at the end will have some controversy. Also on the card, kickboxing takes center stage as super heavyweight legend Daniel Ghita takes on Gokhan Saki.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T34 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Episode 3 from Fukuoka, Japan.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 4 of 4.

programme.desc: Nous vivons dans un monde où chacun met en scène sa vie, ses convictions et même son bonheur. Comme si la vérité reculait devant le désir de modeler les opinions, d'où la prolifération de la désinformation qui n'épargne pas l'islam et les musulmans. Le sociologue et philosophe Raphaël Liogier nous invite à regarder en face cette hypocrisie collective et plaide pour le retour à une vision spirituelle et inspirante de la grandeur humaine...

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 104
programme.desc: Nos anos 1920, Rafael e Luna se apaixonam. Assassinada a mando da invejosa Cristina, Luna reencarna como Serena e novamente se apaixona por Rafael, confirmando o amor eterno.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 26
programme.desc: Guta desmoraliza Tenório na frente da mãe. José Leôncio decide se divorciar de Madeleine. Jove recobra a consciência e Juma fica feliz. José Leôncio vai embora da mansão dos Novaes. O Velho do Rio diz a Juma que Jove não vai mais sair do Pantanal. Tibério se surpreende quando Jove afirma que não deixará a tapera. Tadeu avisa que Jove está vivo e Zé Leôncio dá a notícia para a família de Madeleine.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 152
programme.desc: Marta aceita pedido de Maurílio para conseguir tirar José Pedro da cadeia. Cláudio consegue provas contra Enrico. Cora ajuda José Pedro. Cristina desconfia da fortuna de Maurílio.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 140
programme.desc: Stela recusa o pedido de Agnello para viajar com ele. Noronha ameaça Laura e afirma que ela precisa ajudá-lo a acabar com a investigação de Mauro. Diana desconfia da ligação entre Laura e Noronha. Candê se descontrola com o delegado e acaba presa por desacato à autoridade. Diogo consegue fazer Gemma contar o que sabe sobre Clara.
